paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s girls will open the Big River Steel Lion Classic against Forrest City of Arkansas at 2:30 p.m. Monday, Dec. 28. The Warriors drew game four in the eight-team girls bracket the tournament organizer released and Pontotoc Athletics shared Monday.

The first game determines when Pontotoc plays Tuesday, Dec. 29. A win sends the Warriors to a 7 p.m. semifinal against the winner of Manila and Yazoo City. A loss puts Pontotoc in the 1 p.m. game against the loser of that same matchup. Manila and Yazoo City play at 8:30 p.m. on opening night.
All eight teams have a game Wednesday, Dec. 30. Seventh place is decided at 10 a.m., fifth place at 1 p.m. and third place at 4 p.m. The girls championship starts at 7 p.m.
